PAGE TITLE: Mensaje del Director Financiero

PHOTOS: Portrait of Margaret Vo Schaus, Chief Financial Officer. Caption: "Atentamente, Margaret V. Schaus, Margaret Vo Schaus"

KEY FACTS:
- Fiscal Year 2024 Financial Report of the Agency (AFR) of the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA).
- The OCFO (Office of the Chief Financial Officer) ensures financial statements are precise, transparent, and timely.
- NASA's fiscal year 2024 financial statements received an unmodified ("clean") audit opinion for the 14th consecutive year.
- Independent auditors identified one material weakness related to financial controls, but no instances of noncompliance with laws and regulations.
- Objectives of the Office of the Chief Financial Officer: Objective I (Ensure trusted stewardship of taxpayer investments), Objective II (Lead and develop a community with strong analytical capabilities), and Objective III (Develop and achieve business workforce participation).
